name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively maintained with frequent patch releases across multiple supported branches simultaneously. The latest release is v0.62.2 (Open Source) / v1.62.2 (Enterprise), released on June 17, 2025. Multiple stable branches (v0.57–v0.62) are receiving concurrent patch updates, indicating a mature long-term support model. Release notes are available at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases, with separate Open Source and Enterprise builds distributed via Docker and JAR.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license.
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases across several version branches were published on June 17, 2025.
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase Cloud is available at metabase.com as a managed hosted offering.
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition.
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, MongoDB, Druid, Oracle, Presto/Trino, Spark SQL, and more via drivers.

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau offers best-in-class visualization and enterprise features but is expensive and proprietary, making it a costly alternative to Metabase's open-source model.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash integrates tightly with dbt for a metrics-as-code workflow, making it more developer-oriented and structured than Metabase's more generalist self-service approach.
